title: Staff Public Account workspace and client search
summary: Staff can find Public Accounts and Public Profiles from Ctrl K and the Clients directory, then open a shared workspace with Overview, Account Management, Account Profile Management, Records and Activity.
changes: Ctrl K includes a People group that finds clients by name, email, username, phone, postcode, date of birth or reference, gated by staff.clients.search.
Clients is a directory with All, With account, Profile only and Invited tabs, text badges, and URL-synced search and Account state filters.
Opening a person shows five workspace tabs shared by Staff Clients and Admin Public Accounts; old details and access tab URLs redirect.
Overview folds PIN check, call log, notes and quick actions; Account Management and Account Profile Management surface access and personal details (date of birth needs staff.clients.sensitive).
Records and Activity load only on their tabs and keep module and date filters in the URL.
Caller show URLs redirect into the Clients workspace; Find a caller uses the same people search.
Staff guide and Help describe the directory, badges and workspace tabs.
affected_areas: Staff and Admin Public Account workspace tabs
Caller find and PIN verification on Overview
version_rationale: MINOR: brings the Public Account workspace into Staff with directory tabs and global people search without removing existing accounts.
validation: PHPUnit StaffPublicAccountWorkspaceTest, UserProfileHubTest, StaffClientAccountTest, RecordSearchTest, CallerVerificationTest and related filters.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for Clients directory and workspace tabs.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.78.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Creating a MyAPES account from a Profile only row remains out of scope (v0.79.0).
Profile matching and account linking remain out of scope (v0.81.0).
Resend invite on Invited rows is reserved for a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.77.0). No schema migrations ship in this release.
provenance: Milestone v0.78.0 Staff Public Account workspace and client search, Epic #866, pull request #1071.
